architecture: BatchAutoTranslate partitions a project/workspace by translation (component/language), applies a global cap, and invokes AutoTranslate per translation. AutoTranslate optionally pre-translates writable rows, then run_judge_batch. run_judge_batch resolves both seats, reuses only complete two-seat cache hits, and runs both seats concurrently with same-batch acknowledgement barriers. Each seat's request_verdicts adapts batch width and invokes _run_batch, which may retry, fail over, or isolate parser failures. Repair MT is separate from JudgeRequestAttempt accounting; successful repairs can trigger additional one-unit candidate/live rejudge calls. Deferral draining intentionally selects one seat and bypasses cache.
report: Exact clean baseline: E_initial = Σ_s ceil(U/B_s); with U=2000, B1=B2=5, E=800. Effective execution: for each request round r, seat s, batches b at adaptive width B_eff(r,s), outbound attempts are primary POST + eligible transport/transient/protocol retries (shared RetryBudget/deadline bounded) + at most one fallback POST on auth/failover; parser failures may recursively isolate to width-one calls. Add all-selected-seat unparsed retry rounds, repair mutation rounds, candidate proposal rejudges, and any concurrent redelivery duplicates. Static preview/worst-case counts do not include adaptive width collapse, fallback/isolation details, or concurrent duplicate delivery. The observed ~3000 attempts/run is therefore not explained by global batch=5; it requires measured decomposition. A useful diagnostic is average width 2*2000/3000≈1.33 if each seat-unit is judged once, but retries/duplicates invalidate that as attribution. Candidate explanations ranked by leverage: (1) adaptive budget collapse to 1–2 after deadline/transport failures (directly supported by code, current history not retained); (2) concurrent late-ack redelivery processing PENDING rows in parallel (supported as a race by orchestration, but no broker receipt proof); (3) retries/fallback/parser isolation/unparsed retry rounds (all code-supported, per-run contribution unknown); (4) repair/candidate rejudge recursion (code-supported, but Anvil summary repaired=0 does not exclude failed repair MT and does not prove candidate recursion). Production aggregation must group JudgeRequestAttempt by run, seat, attempt ordinal, batch_digest/size, provider/model/profile fingerprint, request_round via verdict joins, failure_kind, parsed, elapsed/first_byte/response bytes/status, and token fields; join LLMUsageLog by request_attempt/run for cost (null cost=unpriced), unit_count, batch_size, operation/service, outcome. Join JudgeRunUnit for cached/outcome/repair_status/attempt_count and JudgeVerdict for subject live/candidate, attempt/request_round, unparsed, profile/provider/hash identities. Also inspect current JudgeAdaptiveState batch_budget/circuit/failure streak, noting it is current state rather than historical.
